title: Leaderboard split — signal vs staking (rank is signal-only)
description: The rank column is computed from the SIGNAL block only: flat-stake hit rate, ranked on the 95% lower bound against the standard -110 reference hurdle. The STAKING block (ROI at actual stakes, profit, drawdown) is reported beside it and can never change a rank. Source dataset: data/leaderboard.csv (computed layer over third-party data — flagged), stakes flat 1 unit. The dataset's breakeven_hit column is circular (flag F25) and is transcribed only for audit.
ranking_rule: signal_rank = order by (hit_ci_low - reference_hurdle) descending; ties break on larger settled sample. Profit and ROI are reported, never ranked on.
demotion: No entry is LIVE in this dataset (all verdicts REJECTED/UNRANKED pending gates), so gate G-14 (engine/demotion.py) has nothing to demote yet; it will apply the moment an entry goes live.
